name: DocumentReviewBatchConsole
tagline: Run managed document review like a project: batches, capacity, QC sampling and a deadline forecast in one Power Platform app.
description: An eDiscovery managed-review console for litigation support teams, review centres and ALSPs. Assign review batches within reviewer capacity, log coding progress, size statistically valid QC samples, pass or rework batches against an overturn limit, spot inconsistent coding and unrealistic pace, and see when the review will finish compared with the production deadline – on canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: 10 drill-down KPIs incl. overturn rate and projected finish
Status workflow with allowed transitions and required fields
QC sample sizing (confidence, margin, finite population, minimum)
12 automatic flags (pace per phase, responsive/privilege outliers, capacity, overdue…)
Bulk assign / priority / move, undo, CSV export
Phone layout with bottom view switcher, keyboard shortcuts
